newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - School District #3, Oklahoma.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE OF BONDS
Independent School District Number 3
(Muskogee County)
Oklahoma
Building Bonds of 1997
(Participants in the Oklahoma Commissioners of the Land
Office School
District Bond Guarantee Program)
(Bank Qualified)(Non-Callable)
Place and Time of Sale
The Board of Education of Independent School District Number 3 of Muskogee County, Oklahoma (the School
District''), will receive sealed bids at the Board Meeting Room, Administration Building, Fort Gibson Public Schools, 500 South Ross, Fort Gibson, Oklahoma, until 12:00 o'clock Noon, Tuesday,
November 19, 1996,
for the sale of its $4,500,000 Building Bonds of 1997 (the Bonds''), more completely described in the Preliminary Official Statement''.

Sealed bids, plainly marked Bid for Bonds'' may be maile to the Schools District's Financial Advisor, Stephen H. McDonald & Associates, Inc., ATTN: Stephen McDonald, 3801 N.W. 63rd St., Bldg #3, Suite 160, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma 73116. Sealed bids must be submitted in duplicate on the Official Bid Form.
Dated Date of the Bonds: January 1, 1997.
Interest Payment Date: January 1 and July 1, commencing July 1, 1998.
Due Principal Due Principal
January 1 Amount January 1 Amount
Types of Bid and Interest Rates
The Bonds will be sold in one block all or none, and no bid of less than par and accrued interest will be

considered. bidders must specify the rate or rates of interest the Bonds will bear. No interest rate in excess of ten percent (10%) will be considered. The spread between the highest and lowest interest rate bid shall not exceed three percent (3%) and the interest rate bid on any maturity of Bonds maturing in the years 2005 through and including 2007 must equal or exceed the interest rate bid on the

immediately proceeding maturity of Bonds. Bidders shall specify the rate or rates of interest in multiples of one- eighth (1/8) or one-twentieth (1/20) of one percent per annum. Bidders are not restricted as to the number of rates
that may be named, provided that the same rate shal specified for all bond of the same maturity.
Good Faith Deposit

Each bid must accompanied by a good faith deposit in the form of a Certified or Cashier's check made payable to the Treasurer of the School District in the amount of two percent (2%) of the par value of the bonds. The good faith deposit of the successful bidder will be retained by the School District in assure performance of the contract on the part of said bidder. In the event said bidder should fail or refuse to take up and pay for the bonds in accordance with his bid, then said check will be cashed as full liquidated damages. Otherwise, said check will be returned to the purchaser upon payment for the Bonds. No interest will be allowed on said check. Checks of unsuccessful bidders will be promptly returned.
Delivery
Delivery of the Bonds shall be made at any bank in Oklahoma City or Tulsa, Oklahoma, designated by the
purchaser, against payment of the agreed upon purchase price. Delivery of the Bonds to the purchaser is anticipated on or about January 10, 1997.
Additional Information
Additional information may be obtained from the School District's Financial Advisor, Stephen H. McDonald &
Associates, Inc., 3801 N.W. 63rd St., Bldg #3, Suite 160, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma 73116, Telephone: (405) 843-1640.
(From The Bond Buyer)
